class Runner:
    async def in_order(self, items: list[object], step: Step, *, reason: str):
        for item in items:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await client.put(item)
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            await audit.save(item)


async def use():
    await Runner().in_order([], step, reason="Each update reads the previous write")
